notes: Strategy-relevant sporting shape for 2024: no refuelling during the race. A dry race searches slick compounds only, so Intermediate and Wet cannot lift the two-compound rule. A wet race can use a wet-weather tyre, and that tyre lifts the slick rule. This is not an FIA text. Compound life and pace are set per event.

car_defaults.note: Fuel mass is an order-of-magnitude assumption so an impossible load can be refused. It is not a measured car.
